mapper.select: SELECT id, data_date, server_id, job_id, power_top, power_bottom, power_median, power_average, power_total, power_var, power_sd FROM daily_power WHERE data_date = #{baseTime}

SELECT count(ds.c_name) count_class, jc.job_name job_name, ds.data_date data_date FROM deian_server ds LEFT JOIN job_code jc ON ds.job_id = jc.job_id WHERE ds.c_power >= (SELECT max(power_bottom) FROM daily_power WHERE data_date = #{baseTime}) AND ds.data_date = #{baseTime} GROUP BY jc.job_name ORDER BY count_class DESC
